entries: And what will you do now that you are free?
如今你自由了，接下来打算做什么？
It seems only right that I return it, but who does it belong to?
把它还回去才是正理，可它究竟属于谁呢？
And the book? Will you take it with you, or see it to its master?
那本书，你打算带在身边，还是送它回到主人那里？
Then it is settled. We return the book. Then I will continue my search.
那就定了。我们归还那本书。然后我继续我的寻找。
I do wish I could remember... We should ask around town. Perhaps someone will know of the book.
我真希望自己能想起来……我们该在镇上四处问问。也许有人知道这本书。
And I shall go with you, friend. You are talented at finding trouble it seems.
我会与你同行，朋友。看来你很擅长招惹麻烦。
And I happen to be looking for trouble.
I suppose I will continue looking for my sheep.
我大概会继续找我的羊。
